messages:
maya: FYI the VPC egress default-deny + the tightened KMS key policy we pushed this morning are blocking keystore decrypts for warm-pool GPU nodes in us-west-2. join rate dropped ~45%.

maya: sample log:
```
ERROR keystore.decrypt node=wp-9 status=403 error=AccessDenied reason=MissingCondition aws:SourceVpc=vpc-0a1b2c
WARN warmup.join node=wp-9 reason=\"keystore handshake timeout\"
```

ivan: that message means requests arriving via the keystore privatelink don't present aws:SourceVpc as expected. key policy used SourceVpc equality.

rachel: urgent mitigations: (A) issue temporary KMS grants scoped to warmpool role ARNs (fast, low cost), (B) short TTL firewall allowlist for keystore privatelink ENIs (quick, has NAT/egress cost), (C) relax key policy to allow SourceVpce (longer, sec review).

tom: prefer (A) immediately. grants have small audit footprint and we can auto-retire. I'll draft grant calls.

aj: I'll open a short fw exception CR TTL=60m as backup (FW-CR 6222) and tag with `keystore-temp`. keep it audited and TTL enforced.

tom: created grants: grantARN=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:grant/g-55aa33 scoped->arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/warmpool-role RetireAfter=2h. posting to ticket.

iv an: nice. any cost estimate if we need fw exception? rachel?

rachel: rough: NAT + audit shipper ~ $700-1.2k/day for the region while exception is live. pre-approved for <24h with SOC annotation.

ops-bot: INC-8722 opened for keystore decrypt failures. Linked FW-CR 6222 and grant g-55aa33. Estimated cost impact $950/day if fw used. Escalate to security@redwood if grants remain >2h.

tom: after grants, warm-pool joins recovered to ~97% within 10m. KMS 403 rate back to baseline.

ivan: followups: add infra linter rule to flag SourceVpc vs SourceVpce when privatelink endpoints exist; add warm-pool bootstrap canary to rollout gates for KMS/VPC policy changes; add automated retire job for temp grants.

rachel: will open followup tickets and schedule sec review for key policy change to SourceVpce. prefer the long-term fix but scoped and tested.

maya: thanks all. I'll draft a short postmortem draft and assign followups. closing when grant retired and FW-CR removed.
